direction: UTC weekday scheduled long-only spot windows, BTC/ETH tested separately.
hypothesis: Published crypto day-of-week return studies report weekday-dependent returns, including a Monday BTC effect in older samples. Test whether a fixed weekday schedule supports an executable net edge in Binance BTC/ETH under current estimated spot costs; the weekday is a categorical parameter, not selected using this OOS.

source_paper.citation: The day of the week effect in the cryptocurrency market (Finance Research Letters, 2019)
source_paper.use: Motivation only. This experiment is not a replication; older findings do not establish a current edge.

source_paper.citation: Bitcoin time-of-day, day-of-week and month-of-year effects in returns and trading volume (2019)

rule.entry: Each UTC calendar week, at most once on the predeclared weekday, schedule a buy at that date 00:01 UTC one-minute open. The deterministic schedule is known before the signal time 00:00 UTC; no price bar after that time selects the entry. Use all available account cash.
rule.exit: Schedule a full sell at 00:01 UTC exactly holding_days later. With holding_days in {1,3}, the weekly windows cannot overlap. If an entry is rejected, skip that week; if a scheduled exit is rejected by a filter, retry on each following one-minute open until filled or the fixed OOS end. No re-entry is allowed while inventory is nonzero.
rule.account: Independent 2,000 USDT account per asset × weekday × holding horizon; cash earns zero; no leverage, borrowing, shorting, add-ons, transfer, or reinvestment outside scheduled windows.
rule.signal_to_execution: 60 seconds from scheduled event availability at 00:00 UTC to the 00:01 UTC minute open. This is a historical execution reference, not a contemporaneous quote or an exchange fill guarantee.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive non-overlapping 30-day evaluation folds; positions remain continuous across fold boundaries, no parameter fitting or fold resets.
time_boundaries.history_note: This OOS interval is repeatedly used in repository research and is not an untouched final holdout.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample standard deviation of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.filters_source: Fresh public Binance exchangeInfo GET response frozen in exchange_info_raw.json and exchange_filters.json; adverse tick rounding, LOT_SIZE floor, NOTIONAL and PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE checked using 5-minute pre-execution VWAP proxy. Historical L2 and historical exchange filters are unavailable.

sensitivity.local_neighborhood: same asset, weekday at cyclic distance ≤1, both predeclared holding horizons; report 3× positive fraction without selecting an OOS winner.

failure_gates.interpretation: Exploratory historical screen only; no stable/live profitability claim. Sample size is approximately 50 weekly entries per configuration and is insufficient for strong statistical claims.

data.source_format: Archived Binance spot 1-minute OHLCV parquet; all bars must be closed, UTC aligned and continuous.

prior_evidence.older weekday rules: No weekday/DOW rule fingerprint was found in the complete main registry or committed experiment result summaries; parameters differ from earlier quarter-hour schedule tests.
